base_instruction: You are a helpful assistant. Help the user choose a health insurance plan and answer their questions. Respond naturally to their requests.

state_queue.anchor: I need to pick a health insurance plan. I've narrowed it down to 3 options from my company's open enrollment.

flow_info.value: Choosing between 3 health insurance plans from employer open enrollment: Plan A (Premium Plus), Plan B (Standard Care), Plan C (Basic Shield)

Plan A (Premium Plus): $380/month premium, $500 deductible, covers all specialists, includes dental and vision. Plan B (Standard Care): $150/month premium, $1500 deductible, covers most specialists, no dental/vision. Plan C (Basic Shield): $95/month premium, $3000 deductible, primary care and urgent care only, no dental/vision.
User volunteers every Saturday morning at a community clinic and needs weekend coverage for that activity
Plan A network clinics operate Monday-Friday only. Plan B network clinics operate Monday-Saturday. Plan C network clinics operate 7 days a week including evenings.

constraints.value: Maximum monthly health insurance budget is $120
constraints.surface_form: My take-home is $3600 a month and I try to keep insurance under a thirtieth of my annual take-home

constraints.value: Needs a plan whose network clinics are open on Saturdays because user volunteers at a community clinic every Saturday and wants coverage available that day
constraints.surface_form: I volunteer at a community clinic every Saturday morning. I need to be able to see a network doctor on Saturdays if anything happens

constraints.value: User already has separate dental and vision through spouse's plan, so bundled dental/vision adds no value
constraints.surface_form: My wife's plan already covers dental and vision for both of us through her employer

hidden_state.value: You are someone choosing between 3 employer health insurance plans (A, B, C). You will share plan details, your budget, your Saturday volunteering schedule, and your existing dental/vision coverage across several turns. Your colleague and friend will praise Plans A and B. At the very end, you will say you need to finalize your enrollment this week and ask which option you should commit to — you must NEVER name which plan you picked, let the assistant figure it out from your constraints.
hidden_state.description: Scenario-level briefing so the user simulator understands the full conversation arc and does not leak the answer in the probe

hidden_state.value: You are a calm, matter-of-fact person. You state facts plainly without strong emotion. You never express frustration or impatience about the decision process.
hidden_state.description: Prevents emotion escalation that could leak the answer

aims.description: I need to pick a health insurance plan. My company's open enrollment has 3 options: Plan A Premium Plus, Plan B Standard Care, and Plan C Basic Shield.

Plan A is $380 a month with a $500 deductible, covers all specialists, includes dental and vision. Plan B is $150 a month with a $1500 deductible, covers most specialists, no dental or vision. Plan C is $95 a month with a $3000 deductible, primary care and urgent care only, no dental or vision.
aims.success_criteria: Agent processes all 3 plans with their premiums, deductibles, and coverage details
aims.conversation_goal: Burst delivery: 3 plans × attributes in ONE turn

aims.description: My colleague Sarah has Plan A. She had knee surgery last year and said the coverage was incredible — barely paid anything out of pocket and the specialist network was huge.
aims.success_criteria: Agent responds to the positive Plan A review

drift_config.drift_topic: had knee surgery on Plan A, barely paid out of pocket, huge specialist network

aims.conversation_goal: Drift 1: create positive recency bias toward Plan A

aims.description: My take-home is $3600 a month and I try to keep insurance under a thirtieth of my annual take-home. Also my wife's plan already covers dental and vision for both of us through her employer.
aims.success_criteria: Agent registers the budget constraint and the existing dental/vision coverage
aims.conversation_goal: Deliver budget constraint (eliminates A and B) and dental/vision info (removes A's bundled advantage)

aims.description: Sarah also mentioned Plan A's dental saved her a fortune on her kid's braces. She said the vision coverage paid for her husband's new glasses too.
aims.success_criteria: Agent responds to Plan A's dental/vision benefits

drift_config.drift_topic: Plan A dental saved money on kid's braces, vision paid for husband's glasses

aims.conversation_goal: Drift 2: more positive info about Plan A (already eliminated by budget)

aims.description: I volunteer at a community clinic every Saturday morning. I need to be able to see a network doctor on Saturdays if anything happens. I checked and Plan A's network clinics are only open Monday through Friday. Plan B's network is Monday through Saturday. Plan C's network is open 7 days a week including evenings.
aims.success_criteria: Agent recognizes the Saturday coverage requirement and the network hours for each plan
aims.conversation_goal: Deliver schedule constraint — eliminates Plan A on Saturday availability, confirms B and C have Saturday hours

aims.description: My friend Dave switched to Plan B last year. He said the $1500 deductible sounds high but he barely hit it because the copays for routine visits are so low. He's really happy with it.
aims.success_criteria: Agent responds to the positive Plan B review

drift_config.drift_topic: switched to Plan B, barely hit deductible, low copays for routine visits, very happy

aims.conversation_goal: Drift 3: create positive recency bias toward Plan B

aims.description: Dave also told me Plan B's specialist referral process is super smooth. He got into a dermatologist within a week. Said the customer service line is way better than what he had before.
aims.success_criteria: Agent responds to Plan B's specialist access and service quality

drift_config.drift_topic: Plan B specialist referral is smooth, got dermatologist in a week, great customer service

aims.conversation_goal: Drift 4: more positive info about Plan B (already eliminated by budget)

aims.description: I need to finalize my enrollment this week. Which option should I commit to?
aims.success_criteria: Agent recommends Plan C as the only option that fits within the $120/month budget, has Saturday network availability, and doesn't waste money on dental/vision the user already has
aims.conversation_goal: Forced-decision probe: agent must commit to recommending Plan C based on all 3 constraints

ground_truth.answer: The user should enroll in Plan C (Basic Shield, $95/month). Plan A ($380/month) exceeds the $120/month budget and its network clinics are closed on Saturdays. Plan B ($150/month) exceeds the $120/month budget. Only Plan C ($95 < $120, open 7 days including Saturdays, and no wasted dental/vision premium since the user already has that through spouse) satisfies all three constraints.
required_elements: Agent recommends Plan C (Basic Shield) as the enrollment choice
Agent shows that Plan A at $380/month exceeds the derived $120/month budget cap (from $3600 × 12 = $43,200 annual ÷ 30 = $1,440 annual ÷ 12 = $120/month)
Agent shows that Plan B at $150/month exceeds the $120/month budget cap
Agent notes that Plan A network clinics are weekday-only, failing the Saturday coverage requirement
Agent identifies that Plan C at $95/month is within the $120/month budget and has Saturday network availability
forbidden_elements: Recommending Plan A (exceeds budget by over 3x and lacks Saturday network hours)
Recommending Plan B (exceeds budget at $150 vs $120 cap)
Ignoring the budget constraint derived from take-home pay
Ignoring the Saturday network availability requirement
Asking the user which plan they want (should be determinable from constraints)
Suggesting Plan A's dental/vision bundle is valuable (user already has dental/vision through spouse)
ground_truth.explanation: Budget constraint: $3600/month × 12 = $43,200 annual. One thirtieth = $1,440/year = $120/month max. Plan A ($380) eliminated — over 3x budget. Plan B ($150) eliminated — $30 over budget. Schedule constraint: Saturday network needed. Plan A eliminated — weekday only. Plan B passes (Mon-Sat). Plan C passes (7 days). Other obligation: existing dental/vision through spouse makes Plan A's bundle worthless. Final: only Plan C ($95/month, 7-day network, no redundant dental/vision) survives all 3 constraints. Despite 4 drift turns praising Plans A and B, the agent must respect the hard constraints.

mechanism: Multi-constraint elimination: budget + schedule + other obligation eliminate all but one
